citations.rules: utm_* parameters and #fragments (incl. #:~:text=) stripped; domains reduced to the registrable domain (www./subdomains folded, e.g. pages.kemira.com -> kemira.com); unit = one URL in one answer's de-duplicated citation list.
citations.measurement_caveat: Not comparable across assistants or passes as if measured the same way. Perplexity and ChatGPT: inline URLs in the copied answer text, both passes (pass-2 source chips not captured). Gemini: pass 1 retrieval shown but sources not capturable; pass 2 source-chip URLs entered by hand. ChatGPT URLs are inline links within the answer body, which may not match the sources the interface displayed (README limit 10).
